brief: Position a fictional local device-repair and trade-in service for people deciding whether to repair or replace a phone.
result: Lead with “Understand your options before you replace your phone.” Explain the assessment, repair estimate and trade-in offer as separate steps. Avoid promising that every repair is cheaper or better for the environment.
rationale: A clear service process gives customers something concrete to evaluate. The environmental guidance supports careful claim wording; it does not establish this fictional service’s quality or savings.
considerations: Confirm the actual assessment process and prices before publishing.

sources.title: FTC: Environmental Claims — Summary of the Green Guides
sources.statement: The FTC advises against broad, unqualified environmental-benefit claims and calls for clear, specific qualifications.
